source.title: Harmony4D test/03_grappling2.zip, sequence 043_grappling2
source.author: Rawal Khirodkar, Jyun-Ting Song, Jinkun Cao, Zhengyi Luo, Kris Kitani (Carnegie Mellon University), Harmony4D, NeurIPS 2024
source.notes: Multi-view triangulated COCO-17 3D keypoints (processed_data/poses3d), 20 fps, both people. Floor fitted to the ankles; hands are the wrists, neck the mid-shoulders, head the mid-ears; toes are not tracked and are placed one foot-length ahead of the ankle along the pelvis's facing. Converted with the motion tools documented in docs/research/footage-sources.md.

review_provenance.notes: Frames are consecutive original samples. Left uses unmodified MotionPlayback joint positions. Right optionally retargets legs with the actual rig's per-side lengths while retaining the common pair scale and pelvis trajectory. Unreachable ankles are explicitly reported, not preserved. Toe vectors and foot roll are inferred; there are no verified foot-contact labels. The source floor is fitted to ankle samples, not measured shoe soles. Panel offsets are display-only. No physics or production clip assignment.

notes: Camera images and Unity frames are resized preserving aspect ratio and padded; no crop or image reconstruction. Camera view differs from the aligned model side view; no pixel alignment is implied.
